purchaseOrders[].Company_Code.description: Company code. Required; must be a valid company.

purchaseOrders[].PO_Number.description: Purchase order number. Required; leave blank to auto-assign the next PO number.

purchaseOrders[].Vendor_Code.description: Vendor code. Required; valid vendor code must exist in the company.

purchaseOrders[].Warehouse_Code.description: Warehouse code. Required unless no non-direct cost detail records are included.

purchaseOrders[].Job_Number.description: Job number. Required unless a valid warehouse code is defined and there are no direct job cost detail records.

purchaseOrders[].VAT_Code.description: VAT code. Must exist in the company when used.

purchaseOrders[].Status_Flag.description: PO status. P = Proposed, O = Open, C = Closed. Blank defaults to Proposed.

purchaseOrders[].Cost_Center.description: Cost center code. Must be valid if cost centers are enabled.

purchaseOrders[].Remarks.description: Remarks code or free text, up to 29 characters.

purchaseOrders[].Special_Instructions.description: Special instructions code or free text, up to 29 characters.

purchaseOrders[].Ship_To_Code.description: Ship-to code. D = Default, J = Job, I = Input. Blank defaults to D.

purchaseOrders[].Ship_Name.description: Ship-to name. Required when ship-to code is I.

purchaseOrders[].Ship_Address_1.description: Ship-to address line 1. Required when ship-to code is I.

purchaseOrders[].Ship_City.description: Ship-to city. Required when ship-to code is I.

purchaseOrders[].Ship_State.description: Ship-to state. Required when ship-to code is I.

purchaseOrders[].Ship_Zip_Code.description: Ship-to postal code. Required when ship-to code is I.

purchaseOrders[].Ship_Via.description: Ship via code or free text. Blank defaults from Purchase Order Installation.

purchaseOrders[].Ship_Terms.description: Shipping terms code or free text. Blank defaults from Purchase Order Installation.

purchaseOrders[].FOB.description: FOB text. Blank defaults from Purchase Order Installation.

purchaseOrders[].Confirmed_By.description: Confirmed by. Blank defaults from Purchase Order Installation.

purchaseOrders[].PO_Order_Date.description: Order date in MM/DD/CCYY format. Blank defaults to the current PO processing date.

purchaseOrders[].Batch_Code.description: Batch code. Blank defaults to the operator code from Authorization_ID.

purchaseOrders[].Terms_Code.description: Payment terms basis. A = Based on invoice date, B = Based on first of next month.

purchaseOrders[].Payment_Days.description: Payment number of days. Must be non-negative.

purchaseOrders[].Discount_From_Code.description: Discount due basis. A = Based on invoice date, B = Based on first of next month.

purchaseOrders[].Discount_Days.description: Discount number of days. Must be non-negative.

purchaseOrders[].Terms_Percent.description: Discount percent. Enter 12.34 for 12.34%; must be non-negative.

purchaseOrders[].Terms_Description.description: Terms description, up to 20 characters. Constructed automatically when blank.

purchaseOrders[].Resale_Flag.description: For resale flag. Y = For resale, N = Not for resale.

purchaseOrders[].Tax_Code.description: Default sales/use tax code. Must exist in the company when used.

purchaseOrders[].Routing_Code.description: Routing code. Must exist in the company when used.

purchaseOrders[].PO_Method.description: Receiving method. Must be 1 or 2 when supplied.

purchaseOrders[].PO_Type.description: Pricing type. U = Unit price, L = Lump sum.

purchaseOrders[].Bank_Account_Code.description: Credit card account code. Must be a credit-card type account when used.

purchaseOrders[].Card_Number.description: Card number. Required if the account tracks card numbers.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Detail_Entr.description: Detail entry type. D = Defined item code, N = Non-stock item, M = Message-only.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].PO_Quantity.description: Quantity. Required and non-zero unless this is a message-only line.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Item_ID.description: Item ID. Required unless this is a message-only line.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Item_Descri.description: Item description. Used for non-stock items; stock item descriptions default from inventory item master.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Unit_Of_Mea.description: Unit of measure, up to 3 characters.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Item_Price.description: Item price. Blank defaults using Spectrum purchase order rules.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Item_Discou.description: Line discount percent. Enter 12.34 for 12.34%; must be non-negative.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].GL_Account.description: G/L account. Required unless this is a message-only line.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Phase_Code.description: Phase code. Required unless this is a message-only line or non-job purchase.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Cost_Type.description: Cost type. Required unless this is a message-only line or non-job purchase.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Tax_Code.description: Detail sales/use tax code. Must exist in the company when used.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Delivery_Da.description: Detail delivery date in MM/DD/CCYY format.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Message.description: Message text. Required for message-only lines; up to 250 characters.

purchaseOrders[].poDetails[].Cost_Center.description: Detail cost center. Must be valid if cost centers are enabled.
